product.title: Two Nights Deluxe Ranch Experience

description.text: Grand Canyon Western Ranch welcomes you for two nights in upgraded deluxe accommodations with the same ranch activities as standard packages. Horseback rides, wagon tours, ranch meals, and evening entertainment frame a relaxed western stay a short drive from the South Rim.

highlights: Two nights in deluxe ranch accommodations
Included horseback and wagon ride activities
Western ranch setting on the Hualapai Reservation
Optional South Rim day trips from the ranch

start.description: Check in at Grand Canyon Western Ranch, 3750 E Diamond Bar Rd, Peach Springs, AZ 86434.

end.description: Check out from Grand Canyon Western Ranch after your final breakfast.
